basic_info.description:
Welcome to this beautiful three-bedroom, one-bathroom, two-level classic Sunset home. This home includes a mix of timeles charm with modern updates. 

This home invites you into its spacious living room, perfect for relaxation and enjoyment. The kitchen features new recessed lighting, enhancing its appeal. The bathroom has been updated with modern fixtures, new lighting, new vanity and mirror. Step outside to discover a spacious backyard, perfect for entertaining and hosting. Additionally, the front exterior has been freshly painted, and a brand-new roof was installed just a few years back.
 
With its convenient location and stylish upgrades, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Just around the corner, you'll find schools, dining options, and you're only six blocks away from the beach.
